stories.title: U.S. Marshal Service, Stevens County Sheriff's Office arrest Jesse Watkins
stories.summary: The U.S. Marshal Service says Watkins was arrested Wednesday night without incident. Authorities are still seeking Ronald Rutledge Jr.

stories.title: The Salvation Army volunteers bring meals and hope to 250 in need this Thanksgiving
stories.summary: The Salvation Army unites 60 volunteers to serve over 250 meals, illustrating the spirit of community support and gratitude during the holiday season.

stories.title: Two dead, two injured in single-car crash near Cottonwood, Idaho
stories.summary: Idaho State Police were notified of the crash around 11:30 p.m. Wednesday.

stories.title: Jim and Louise Grassi of Post Falls survive harrowing Mississippi River boat collision
stories.summary: The Post Falls couple survived when a tanker lost steering control on the Mississippi River and crashed into the docked cruise ship they were on in New Orleans.

stories.title: Neil Stratton convicted of murdering his mother
stories.summary: Jurors found Stratton guilty of first-degree murder, burglary and destruction of evidence in connection with the death of his mother, 77-year-old Susan Stratton.

stories.title: One dead, one injured after five-vehicle crash in Moses Lake
stories.summary: The accident occurred around 2 p.m. in the 2200 block of West Broadway, according to the Moses Lake Police Department.

stories.title: Last-minute Thanksgiving shoppers stretch their dollars with costs higher
stories.summary: Spokane shoppers are adapting to higher prices by switching up their shopping lists.

stories.title: Second annual Winter Festival & Christmas Market takes over Kendall Yards
stories.summary: The event runs from Nov. 30 to Dec. 19 and features holiday experiences, local shopping, live entertainment and family activities.

stories.title: Suspect in 1986 murder may have dementia, court records show
stories.summary: A judge ordered David Tibbett to undergo a competency evaluation after his attorney said he had trouble understanding his charge and whether he was in jail or not.

stories.title: U.S. Marshals Service increases reward for information on Ronald Alan Rutledge, now searching for second suspect
stories.summary: Authorities say Jesse Watkins was present at the crime scene, also currently under investigation, and may face charges related to the incident.

stories.title: Run Turkey Trots in Spokane and Idaho to burn calories before Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Thanksgiving traditions meet fitness goals with various Spokane and Idaho Turkey Trots on November 26 and 27, offering races for all ages and charity opportunities.

stories.title: Brabeion Academy founder Branden Durst separates from school. State also investigating alleged financial questions
stories.summary: The Idaho Public Charter School Commission is investigating financial irregularities at Brabeion Academy. The academy's founder has confirmed he's stepping away.
